items.title: Kimberly Clark (KMB) Launches Desert Plant Toilet Paper Program
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark has launched a proprietary program to develop toilet paper using fibers from a drought-resistant desert plant called hesperaloe. The initiative is supported by internal testing and a pilot facility in Arizona that focuses on scaling hesperaloe-based hygiene materials. The program aims to reduce reliance on traditional wood-based fibers and address environmental and supply chain concerns in tissue production.
